# TypeScript/JavaScript identity cases

Hand-written synthetic sources cover declared object owners (`const`, `let`,
`var`, exported and local), identifier/string-keyed nesting, computed keys,
unbound arguments/returns, repeated overload signatures, test/mock callbacks,
hook callbacks and JavaScript `.mjs`. No source is copied from the corpus.
Repeated helper calls are intentionally unresolved; their callers and
containment endpoints use the declaration-order identities.

This README is part of the scanned fixture and has its own file node.
